decisions_needed: PARTLY DONE (#216). The preflight job now gates the publishing event: it asserts the tagged commit is an ancestor of origin/main and runs the six gates a tag push never saw, with the publish job behind `needs: preflight`. What remains is repo-settings-only and cannot be done in code: a `v*` TAG ruleset restricting who may CREATE the ref. Required status checks cannot attach to a tag, so that ruleset is about authorship, not verification. KNOWN RESIDUAL, documented in the workflow itself: a tag push resolves the workflow from the TAGGED ref, so a tag placed on a commit predating #216 runs that commit's workflow and is ungated.

RESOLVED, no longer a decision: the release workflow now moves the npm `stable` dist-tag itself, as its last step. Forward-only (refuses to move backward, which a re-run of an older tag would otherwise do silently), prereleases skipped, and verified by reading back /-/package/<pkg>/dist-tags rather than the CDN-cached packument. `stable` is still 11.8.3 on the registry until the next release runs; nothing needs doing by hand to fix that.
